permissions.detail: Requires enabled, amount>0, valid market, live oracle, price<=caller max and payout within shared epoch cap. Caller quote transfer and Treasury mint authorization/dependencies can revert. This catalog does not authorize a transaction.

economic_meaning.detail: BondDepository.sol:103-139,182-188: market0 sends raw USDG directly caller->Treasury; market1 sends canonical LP, not USDG cash. Payout NET9=floor(valueWad*1e9/price); shared cap floor(current supply*25/10000) checked before mint, not epoch-snapshotted. Then mint to depository and note vesting2days. BondCreated depositor is beneficiary to, not necessarily payer. Evidence netnet-standard-bonds-implementation-20261013.
